nodes.name: Metal Blockchain Banking Innovation Program
nodes.summary_es: Programa de investigación gratuito de Metallicus, lanzado en enero de 2024, para que bancos y cooperativas de crédito exploren casos de uso de blockchain (identidad digital, cumplimiento BSA, subredes privadas, tokenización y, desde 2025, stablecoins de prueba). Las cifras de participantes proceden de Metallicus.
nodes.summary_en: Free Metallicus research program, launched in January 2024, for banks and credit unions to explore blockchain use cases (digital identity, BSA compliance, private subnets, tokenization and, since 2025, test stablecoins). Participant figures come from Metallicus.

facts.es: Según Metallicus, el programa se anunció el 10 de enero de 2024 en San Francisco, centrado en identidad digital y cumplimiento de la Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), con talleres y soluciones a medida sin coste para las instituciones.
facts.en: According to Metallicus, the program was announced on January 10, 2024 in San Francisco, focused on digital identity and Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) compliance, with workshops and custom solutions at no cost to institutions.

sources.title: Metal Blockchain – Metal Blockchain introduces its Banking Innovation Program (10-ene-2024)

facts.es: La página del programa lo describe como un programa de investigación de coste cero con colaboración de expertos, talleres, alianzas con fintechs, desarrollo de casos de uso a medida y confidencialidad.
facts.en: The program page describes it as a zero-cost research program offering expert collaboration, workshops, fintech partnerships, custom use-case development and confidentiality.

sources.title: Metal Blockchain – Banking Innovation Program (página del programa)

facts.es: Comunicados de Metallicus de 2024 citan como áreas del programa la identidad digital, el inicio de sesión único (SSO), las subredes privadas y la tokenización de activos, además de becas de I+D y un consejo asesor.
facts.en: Metallicus releases from 2024 list the program's areas as digital identity, single sign-on (SSO), private subnets and asset tokenization, plus R&D grants and an advisory board.

sources.title: Metallicus – Patelco Credit Union joins Metal Blockchain's Banking Innovation Program (16-may-2024)
NASCUS (vía CUToday) – Second credit union enters into partnership with blockchain initiative (20-jun-2024)

facts.es: Según Metallicus, en 2024 se incorporaron al programa más de 16 cooperativas de crédito.
facts.en: According to Metallicus, more than 16 credit unions joined the program in 2024.

sources.title: Metallicus – A year in review (31-dic-2024)

facts.es: El informe trimestral Q1 2025 de Metallicus lista 17 cooperativas de crédito con comunicados de incorporación al programa, además de la asociación MD|DC; no nombra bancos.
facts.en: Metallicus's Q1 2025 quarterly report lists 17 credit unions with program-entry press releases, plus the MD|DC association; it names no banks.

sources.title: Metallicus – Informe trimestral Q1 2025 (PDF)

facts.es: El 16 de junio de 2025 Metallicus lanzó un Stablecoin Pilot Program reservado a participantes del programa, gratuito para ellos, en el que las cooperativas simulan transacciones con una stablecoin de prueba con su marca, sin fondos reales ni custodia de activos digitales.
facts.en: On June 16, 2025 Metallicus launched a Stablecoin Pilot Program reserved for program participants, free for them, in which credit unions simulate transactions with a test stablecoin carrying their brand, with no real funds or digital-asset custody.

sources.title: CUInsight – Metallicus launches Stablecoin Pilot Program for credit unions (16-jun-2025)
CUbroadcast – Metallicus launches Stablecoin Pilot Program for credit unions (16-jun-2025)

facts.es: En el anuncio del piloto, Metallicus afirmó que su red incluye más de 750 cooperativas de crédito a través de ligas, CUSOs y fintechs; es una cifra de alcance indirecto, no de participantes.
facts.en: In the pilot announcement Metallicus stated its network includes 750+ credit unions through leagues, CUSOs and fintechs; this is an indirect-reach figure, not a participant count.

sources.title: CUInsight – Metallicus launches Stablecoin Pilot Program for credit unions (16-jun-2025)

facts.es: Según el informe Q3 2025 de Metallicus, el programa contaba con más de 40 instituciones participantes y más de 15 stablecoins de marca institucional desplegadas en su entorno de pruebas.
facts.en: According to Metallicus's Q3 2025 report, the program had more than 40 participating institutions and more than 15 institution-branded stablecoins deployed in its test environment.

sources.title: Metallicus – Informe trimestral Q3 2025 (PDF)

facts.es: La asociación GoWest (may-2025, comunicado propio) y CrossState CUA (may-2026, comunicado conjunto con contacto de prensa propio) ofrecieron el programa a sus cooperativas como beneficio gratuito.
facts.en: The GoWest association (May 2025, its own release) and CrossState CUA (May 2026, joint release with its own press contact) offered the program to their credit unions as a free benefit.

sources.title: GoWest Credit Union Association – Credit unions embrace blockchain… (comunicado, 28-may-2025)
CUInsight – CrossState & Metallicus launch pilot program (versión con contacto de prensa de CrossState, 15-may-2026)

facts.es: Según Metallicus, MD|DC CUA (may-2025) y Cornerstone League (oct-2025) también ofrecieron el programa o su piloto de stablecoins a sus cooperativas como beneficio gratuito.
facts.en: According to Metallicus, MD|DC CUA (May 2025) and Cornerstone League (Oct 2025) also offered the program or its stablecoin pilot to their credit unions as a free benefit.

sources.title: Newswire – MD|DC Credit Union Association partners with Metallicus (7-may-2025)
Metallicus – Cornerstone Credit Union League stablecoins (9-oct-2025)
CUInsight – Cornerstone League and Metallicus partner to bring stablecoin innovation to credit unions

nodes.name: Velera
nodes.summary_es: CUSO (organización de servicios para cooperativas de crédito) de pagos y tecnología financiera que combina PSCU y Co-op Solutions. Inversor estratégico de Metallicus y, desde agosto de 2025, socio en su Digital Asset Lab.
nodes.summary_en: Payments and financial-technology CUSO (credit union service organization) combining PSCU and Co-op Solutions. Strategic investor in Metallicus and, since August 2025, its partner in Velera's Digital Asset Lab.

facts.es: Según Velera, combina la experiencia de PSCU y Co-op Solutions, atiende a unas 4.000 instituciones financieras, ingresa 1.600 millones de dólares y tiene más de 5.000 empleados; su sede corporativa está en Tampa (Florida).
facts.en: According to Velera, it combines PSCU and Co-op Solutions, serves about 4,000 financial institutions, has $1.6 billion in revenue and more than 5,000 employees; its corporate office is in Tampa, Florida.

sources.title: Velera – About

facts.es: La web de Velera da dos cifras de antigüedad distintas: '45+ años' en su descripción y '48+ años de servicio' en sus datos clave.
facts.en: Velera's website gives two different tenure figures: '45+ years' in its description and '48+ years of service' in its key figures.

sources.title: Velera – About

facts.es: El 20 de agosto de 2025 Velera lanzó su Digital Asset Lab y nombró a Metallicus su primer socio de plataforma; ambas empresas publicaron comunicados ese día.
facts.en: On August 20, 2025 Velera launched its Digital Asset Lab and named Metallicus its first platform partner; both companies published releases that day.

sources.title: Velera – Digital Asset Lab (comunicado, 20-ago-2025)
Metallicus – Metallicus y Velera (20-ago-2025)
PYMNTS – Velera bets on stablecoin growth with Digital Asset Lab

facts.es: En su comunicado, Velera se describe como inversor estratégico de Metallicus. No se divulgan el importe ni la participación.
facts.en: In its release, Velera describes itself as a strategic investor in Metallicus. Neither the amount nor the stake is disclosed.

sources.title: Velera – Digital Asset Lab (comunicado, 20-ago-2025)
Metallicus – Metallicus y Velera (20-ago-2025)

facts.es: El Lab se abriría primero a los participantes de la Innovation Alliance de Velera (socios de plataforma y cooperativas) y se centraría al inicio en I+D sobre stablecoins y depósitos tokenizados, con pruebas de concepto y pilotos posteriores.
facts.en: The Lab would open first to participants in Velera's Innovation Alliance (platform partners and credit unions) and initially focus on stablecoin and tokenized-deposit R&D, followed by proofs of concept and pilots.

sources.title: Velera – Digital Asset Lab (comunicado, 20-ago-2025)
Metallicus – Metallicus y Velera (20-ago-2025)

facts.es: Vladimir Jovanovic, vicepresidente de Innovación de Velera, habló en el anuncio sobre la necesidad de que las cooperativas comprendan su papel ante las stablecoins; por Metallicus intervino su CEO, Marshall Hayner.
facts.en: Vladimir Jovanovic, Velera's VP of Innovation, spoke in the announcement about credit unions needing to understand their role regarding stablecoins; Metallicus CEO Marshall Hayner also spoke.

sources.title: Velera – Digital Asset Lab (comunicado, 20-ago-2025)
Metallicus – Metallicus y Velera (20-ago-2025)

facts.es: El 11 de agosto de 2026 Velera anunció la cohorte inaugural del Digital Asset Lab: nueve cooperativas y cinco proveedores (Anchorage Digital, Mastercard, Stablecore, TRM Labs y TruStage Digital Assets). Metallicus no figura en el anuncio.
facts.en: On August 11, 2026 Velera announced the Digital Asset Lab's inaugural cohort: nine credit unions and five providers (Anchorage Digital, Mastercard, Stablecore, TRM Labs and TruStage Digital Assets). Metallicus does not appear in the announcement.

sources.title: Velera – Digital Asset Lab inaugural cohort (11-ago-2026)

facts.es: El informe Q4 2025 de Metallicus y su carta Q2 2026 no mencionan a Velera.
facts.en: Metallicus's Q4 2025 report and Q2 2026 letter do not mention Velera.

Metallicus – 2026 Q2 Report (6-jul-2026)

nodes.name: InvestiFi
nodes.summary_es: Plataforma de inversión digital (cripto y valores) integrada en la banca en línea y móvil de cooperativas de crédito y bancos comunitarios. En noviembre de 2025 anunció una alianza con Metallicus para ofrecer stablecoins respaldadas por instituciones.
nodes.summary_en: Digital investing platform (crypto and securities) embedded in the online and mobile banking of credit unions and community banks. In November 2025 it announced an alliance with Metallicus to offer institution-backed stablecoins.

facts.es: Según InvestiFi, es una plataforma que permite invertir desde las cuentas de depósito y cuenta con más de 15 integraciones con banca digital y núcleos bancarios.
facts.en: According to InvestiFi, it is a platform that allows investing to and from deposit accounts and has 15+ digital banking and banking-core integrations.

sources.title: CUInsight – InvestiFi announce strategic alliance with Metallicus
CUInsight – InvestiFi secures contract with Truity Credit Union (20-ene-2026)

facts.es: Según su propio comunicado, en 2023 InvestiFi fue la primera empresa en realizar una conversión de cripto a dólares en tiempo real mediante el núcleo bancario.
facts.en: According to its own release, in 2023 InvestiFi was the first company to perform a real-time crypto-to-USD conversion through the banking core.

sources.title: Metallicus – Metallicus–InvestiFi stablecoin alliance (3-nov-2025)
CUInsight – InvestiFi announce strategic alliance with Metallicus

facts.es: El 3 de noviembre de 2025 InvestiFi y Metallicus anunciaron una alianza estratégica para ofrecer stablecoins respaldadas por instituciones en la plataforma de InvestiFi. El comunicado lleva contactos de prensa de ambas empresas y una declaración del cofundador y CEO de InvestiFi, Kian Sarreshteh.
facts.en: On November 3, 2025 InvestiFi and Metallicus announced a strategic alliance to offer institution-backed stablecoins within InvestiFi's platform. The release carries press contacts for both companies and a statement by InvestiFi co-founder and CEO Kian Sarreshteh.

sources.title: CUInsight – InvestiFi announce strategic alliance with Metallicus
Metallicus – Metallicus–InvestiFi stablecoin alliance (3-nov-2025)
InvestiFi – Stablecoin (página propia, 2026)

facts.es: En su propia web (2026), InvestiFi incluye a Metallicus entre las stablecoins comprometidas y marca al emisor, Metal Blockchain, como 'pre-lanzamiento'; en otra tabla de la misma página dice que su custodio BitGo está 'en vivo' con Metallicus, lo que se contradice.
facts.en: On its own website (2026), InvestiFi lists Metallicus among committed stablecoins and marks the issuer, Metal Blockchain, as 'pre-launch'; another table on the same page says its custodian BitGo is 'live' with Metallicus, which is contradictory.

sources.title: InvestiFi – Stablecoin (página propia, 2026)

facts.es: Según el comunicado distribuido por Metallicus, Metallicus aporta la infraestructura (Metal como capa 0 y XPR Network como capa 1). Las instituciones participantes podrían emitir, quemar y mantener sus propias stablecoins, reservadas por la propia entidad, en colaboración con los custodios de InvestiFi, que no se nombran.
facts.en: According to the Metallicus-distributed release, Metallicus supplies the infrastructure (Metal as layer 0, XPR Network as layer 1). Participating institutions could mint, burn and hold their own stablecoins, reserved by the institution itself, in collaboration with InvestiFi's custodians, who are not named.

sources.title: Metallicus – Metallicus–InvestiFi stablecoin alliance (3-nov-2025)
CUInsight – InvestiFi announce strategic alliance with Metallicus

facts.es: El anuncio fue independiente del acuerdo con Cornerstone League (9-oct-2025) y no menciona a esa liga.
facts.en: The announcement was separate from the Cornerstone League agreement (Oct 9, 2025) and does not mention that league.

sources.title: Metallicus – Metallicus–InvestiFi stablecoin alliance (3-nov-2025)
Metallicus – Cornerstone Credit Union League stablecoins (9-oct-2025)

nodes.name: DaLand CUSO
nodes.summary_es: CUSO propiedad de cooperativas de crédito que desarrolla Coin2Core, un puente que integra activos digitales en los núcleos bancarios de las cooperativas. Se alió con Metallicus en agosto de 2025.
nodes.summary_en: Credit-union-owned CUSO that develops Coin2Core, a bridge that integrates digital assets into credit unions' core banking systems. It partnered with Metallicus in August 2025.

facts.es: En agosto de 2024 DaLand se describía como una organización de 15 años. Ese mes St. Cloud Financial Credit Union y Altra Federal Credit Union pasaron a tener la mayoría de su capital, con participaciones minoritarias de otras cooperativas e inversores privados; fue la primera vez que dejó de tener un único accionista.
facts.en: In August 2024 DaLand described itself as a 15-year-old organization. That month St. Cloud Financial Credit Union and Altra Federal Credit Union took majority ownership, with minority stakes from other credit unions and private investors; it was the first time it moved away from a single shareholder.

sources.title: CUInsight – St. Cloud Financial CU announces strategic investment in DaLand CUSO (14-ago-2024)

facts.es: En marzo de 2025 Blaze Credit Union pasó a ser su segundo mayor accionista; St. Cloud Financial CU figura como propietaria principal. Según DaLand, el grupo de propietarios suma más de 7.200 millones de dólares en activos y más de 400.000 socios.
facts.en: In March 2025 Blaze Credit Union became its second-largest shareholder; St. Cloud Financial CU is listed as principal owner. According to DaLand, the owner group has over $7.2 billion in assets and more than 400,000 members.

sources.title: CUInsight – DaLand CUSO welcomes Blaze Credit Union as a shareholder (20-mar-2025)

facts.es: El 13 de enero de 2026 DaLand anunció que Canvas Credit Union (Colorado) se había convertido en propietaria tras desplegar Coin2Core en su entorno Jack Henry Symitar.
facts.en: On January 13, 2026 DaLand announced that Canvas Credit Union (Colorado) had become an owner after deploying Coin2Core in its Jack Henry Symitar environment.

sources.title: CUInsight – DaLand CUSO… Canvas Credit Union becomes latest owner (13-ene-2026)

facts.es: El 5 y el 6 de agosto de 2025 Metallicus y DaLand publicaron sendos comunicados sobre su alianza estratégica: Metallicus aporta su red Metal Blockchain y la capacidad de emitir stablecoins de marca blanca, y DaLand su puente Coin2Core (que ya soportaba BTC, ETH y USDC).
facts.en: On August 5 and 6, 2025 Metallicus and DaLand each published releases on their strategic alliance: Metallicus provides its Metal Blockchain network and white-label stablecoin issuance, and DaLand its Coin2Core bridge (which already supported BTC, ETH and USDC).

sources.title: Metallicus – Metallicus partners with DaLand CUSO (5-ago-2025)
CUInsight – DaLand CUSO empowers credit unions with institution-branded stablecoins (6-ago-2025)

facts.es: Jon Ungerland, CIO de DaLand, declaró en ambos comunicados; habló de los pagos con stablecoins como algo inevitable y del papel de las entidades locales como custodias de la riqueza comunitaria.
facts.en: Jon Ungerland, DaLand's CIO, gave statements in both releases, describing stablecoin payments as inevitable and local institutions as custodians of community wealth.

sources.title: Metallicus – Metallicus partners with DaLand CUSO (5-ago-2025)
CUInsight – DaLand CUSO empowers credit unions with institution-branded stablecoins (6-ago-2025)

facts.es: En septiembre de 2025 DaLand citó su integración con Metallicus para emitir stablecoins de marca de cooperativas al anunciar una alianza con Corelation.
facts.en: In September 2025 DaLand cited its Metallicus integration for credit-union-branded stablecoin issuance when announcing a Corelation partnership.

sources.title: CUbroadcast – DaLand CUSO just broke open the $4 trillion digital asset vault (3-sep-2025)

facts.en: The January 2026 release about Canvas Credit Union does not mention Metallicus or stablecoins.

sources.title: CUInsight – DaLand CUSO… Canvas Credit Union becomes latest owner (13-ene-2026)

nodes.summary_es: Cooperativa de crédito de Minnesota con unos 430 millones de dólares en activos y propietaria principal de DaLand CUSO. En septiembre de 2025 anunció la stablecoin Cloud Dollar ($CLDUSD) sobre Metal Blockchain, con Metallicus y DaLand.
nodes.summary_en: Minnesota credit union with about $430 million in assets and principal owner of DaLand CUSO. In September 2025 it announced the Cloud Dollar ($CLDUSD) stablecoin on Metal Blockchain, with Metallicus and DaLand.

facts.es: CoinDesk y Co-operative News la describen como una cooperativa de Minnesota con más de 400 millones de dólares en activos.
facts.en: CoinDesk and Co-operative News describe it as a Minnesota credit union with over $400 million in assets.

sources.title: CoinDesk (vía Yahoo Finance) – Minnesota credit union to launch stablecoin (10-sep-2025)
Co-operative News – US credit union launches stablecoin crypto (12-sep-2025)

facts.en: A CreditUnions.com article marked as sponsored content (May 2026) places it in Sartell, Minnesota, with $430.0 million in assets, 28,066 members and 5 branches.

sources.title: CreditUnions.com (contenido patrocinado) – A credit union journey into cryptocurrency and stablecoins (11-may-2026)

facts.es: Es la propietaria principal de DaLand CUSO, en la que invirtió en agosto de 2024 junto con Altra.
facts.en: It is the principal owner of DaLand CUSO, in which it invested in August 2024 together with Altra.

sources.title: CUInsight – St. Cloud Financial CU announces strategic investment in DaLand CUSO (14-ago-2024)
CUInsight – DaLand CUSO welcomes Blaze Credit Union as a shareholder (20-mar-2025)

CoinDesk lo había adelantado el 10 de septiembre.
facts.en: On September 16, 2025 Metallicus announced, with statements by Chase Larson (St. Cloud EVP/CLO) and Jeff Levesque (DaLand CEO), that St. Cloud would issue the Cloud Dollar ($CLDUSD) stablecoin on Metal Blockchain, integrated with its core through DaLand's Coin2Core. CoinDesk had reported it on September 10.

CoinDesk (vía Yahoo Finance) – Minnesota credit union to launch stablecoin (10-sep-2025)

facts.en: The claim that CLDUSD would be the first stablecoin issued by a U.S. credit union comes from the credit union and Metallicus; CoinDesk presents it as the institution's own claim.

sources.title: Metallicus – St. Cloud Financial Credit Union to launch first credit union stablecoin (16-sep-2025)
CoinDesk (vía Yahoo Finance) – Minnesota credit union to launch stablecoin (10-sep-2025)

facts.en: According to CreditUnions.com (sponsored content), St. Cloud opened its CU-Digital Asset Vault to all members in March 2026, after a friends-and-family pilot in December and an NCUA audit in late 2025.

sources.title: CreditUnions.com (contenido patrocinado) – A credit union journey into cryptocurrency and stablecoins (11-may-2026)

facts.es: Se anunció para emitirse sobre Metal Blockchain e integrarse en el núcleo de St. Cloud mediante Coin2Core de DaLand. El acceso al Vault estaba previsto para el cuarto trimestre de 2025.
facts.en: It was announced to be issued on Metal Blockchain and integrated into St. Cloud's core through DaLand's Coin2Core. Vault access was planned for Q4 2025.

nodes.name: GoWest Solutions (GoWest Credit Union Association)
nodes.summary_es: Brazo de soluciones de GoWest Credit Union Association, asociación regional de cooperativas de crédito del oeste de EE. UU. En mayo de 2025 anunció una alianza con Metallicus para ofrecer gratis su programa de innovación blockchain a sus cooperativas miembro.
nodes.summary_en: Solutions arm of GoWest Credit Union Association, a regional credit union trade association in the western U.S. In May 2025 it announced a partnership with Metallicus to offer its blockchain innovation program free to member credit unions.

facts.es: El 28 de mayo de 2025 GoWest publicó un comunicado propio sobre la alianza entre GoWest Solutions y Metallicus, que da acceso gratuito a sus cooperativas miembro a un programa de innovación de Metal Blockchain. Hablan su presidente y CEO, Troy Stang, y su Chief Growth Officer, Cameron Smith; no se nombran cooperativas participantes.
facts.en: On May 28, 2025 GoWest published its own release on the partnership between GoWest Solutions and Metallicus, giving its member credit unions free access to a Metal Blockchain innovation program. President & CEO Troy Stang and Chief Growth Officer Cameron Smith are quoted; no participating credit unions are named.

sources.title: GoWest Credit Union Association – Credit unions embrace blockchain… (comunicado, 28-may-2025)

facts.es: El directorio de socios de GoWest Solutions incluye a Metallicus, describiéndolo como CUSO que ofrece billeteras de activos digitales de marca blanca e infraestructura de stablecoins, para cooperativas de Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Oregón, Washington y Wyoming.
facts.en: GoWest Solutions' partner directory lists Metallicus, describing it as a CUSO offering white-label digital-asset wallets and stablecoin infrastructure, for credit unions in Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Oregon, Washington and Wyoming.

sources.title: GoWest Credit Union Association – All Partners: Metallicus

facts.es: Según una página de metalblockchain.org sin fecha, GoWest Solutions se asoció con Metallicus para dar a sus miembros acceso gratuito al programa, que exige firmar un NDA mutuo y un acuerdo de investigación.
facts.en: According to an undated metalblockchain.org page, GoWest Solutions partnered with Metallicus to give its members free access to the program, which requires signing a mutual NDA and a research agreement.
